comparison.objective: Insert both ends of a two-pin lamp tube into opposed sockets and quarter-turn it until dual detents lock. Candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber for safe dynamic stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires coordinated two-hand lifting, simultaneous dual-end pin alignment/insertion, and whole-object rotation into spring detents. Candidate requires small-tool insertion, counterholding, unlocking, fine local rotation, force-limited tightening, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires both ends within 3 mm, both plungers engaged, approximately 90° rotation, hands clear, and 1 s stillness. Candidate requires two repeatable impacts within energy, speed, and stroke limits, no hard-stop strike, and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: The shared primitives of alignment and rotation do not establish overlap: the record tests simultaneous long-object insertion and dual latching, while the candidate tests adjustable damping and lock retention under impact. Candidate rebound, overload, drift-tolerance, and witness-torque details are not numerically specified.
